steps.name: sign-verified-023-and-stage-clean-install-apk-without-installing-or-pairing
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch --no-tags origin fix/release-wireless-adb-20261123
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/fix/release-wireless-adb-20261123)" = "4040efc858a33f50298f5fec2d2b678b159b86c7"
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-023-first-run-src-XXXXXX)"
OUT="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-023-first-run-apk-XXXXXX)"
cleanup() { cd "$ROOT"; git worktree remove --force "$WORK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$OUT"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$WORK" "4040efc858a33f50298f5fec2d2b678b159b86c7"
cd "$WORK"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "4040efc858a33f50298f5fec2d2b678b159b86c7"
grep -q 'versionName = "0.2.3"' app/build.gradle.kts
grep -q 'versionCode = 5' app/build.gradle.kts
echo "SOURCE_SHA=4040efc858a33f50298f5fec2d2b678b159b86c7"
echo "STAGE=BUILD_RELEASE_CANDIDATE_NOT_PUBLIC"
if [[ -z "${ANDROID_HOME:-}" && -d "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" ]]; then export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; fi
./gradlew :app:assembleRelease
UNSIGNED=app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk
test -s "$UNSIGNED"
SIGNER="$(find "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools" -name apksigner -type f 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1)"
ZIPALIGN="$(dirname "$SIGNER")/zipalign"
test -x "$SIGNER" && test -x "$ZIPALIGN"
"$ZIPALIGN" -f -p 4 "$UNSIGNED" "$OUT/aligned.apk"
SIGNED="$OUT/AI-Calls-0.2.3-test.apk"
"$SIGNER" sign --ks "$HOME/.android/debug.keystore" --ks-key-alias androiddebugkey --ks-pass pass:android --key-pass pass:android --out "$SIGNED" "$OUT/aligned.apk"
"$SIGNER" verify "$SIGNED"
CERT="$("$SIGNER" verify --print-certs "$SIGNED" 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1)"
test "$CERT" = fb07493cf97b0a84ec410f7f72f12938b7f9d47151546e15c049c49c27807b11
LOCAL="$HOME/Downloads/AI-Calls-0.2.3-test.apk"
test ! -e "$LOCAL" || { echo "MAC_CANDIDATE_ALREADY_EXISTS_REFUSED=true"; exit 40; }
cp "$SIGNED" "$LOCAL"
test "$(shasum -a 256 "$LOCAL" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(shasum -a 256 "$SIGNED" | awk '{print $1}')"
printf 'APK_SHA256=%s\n' "$(shasum -a 256 "$LOCAL" | awk '{print $1}')"
printf 'APK_BYTES=%s\n' "$(stat -f%z "$LOCAL")"
echo "APK_MAC_PATH=$LOCAL"
echo "MAC_CANDIDATE_READY=true"
echo "STAGE=TRANSFER_TO_PHONE_DOWNLOADS_IF_ADB_CONNECTED"
if SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery 2>/dev/null)"; then
  test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = SM-S906B
  test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r')" = 16
  test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am get-current-user | tr -d '\r')" = 0
  PACKAGE_PATH="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path --user 0 pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if printf '%s\n' "$PACKAGE_PATH" | grep -q '^package:'; then
    echo "PRODUCTION_APP_ALREADY_PRESENT_STOP_PHONE_TRANSFER=true"
  else
    PHONE=/sdcard/Download/AI-Calls-0.2.3-test.apk
    if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell test -e "$PHONE"; then
      echo "PHONE_CANDIDATE_NAME_COLLISION_HOLD=true"
    else
      adb -s "$SERIAL" push "$LOCAL" "$PHONE"
      REMOTE_SHA="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell sha256sum "$PHONE" | awk '{print $1}')"
      LOCAL_SHA="$(shasum -a 256 "$LOCAL" | awk '{print $1}')"
      test "$REMOTE_SHA" = "$LOCAL_SHA"
      echo "PHONE_DOWNLOAD_CANDIDATE_READY=true"
      echo "PHONE_PATH=$PHONE"
    fi
  fi
else
  echo "PHONE_ADB_UNAVAILABLE_MANUAL_TRANSFER_NEEDED=true"
fi
echo "INSTALL_NOT_PERFORMED=true"
echo "WIFI_PAIRING_NOT_PERFORMED=true"
echo "RELEASE_NOT_PUBLISHED=true"
echo "CANDIDATE_STAGING_DONE=true"
